payload.title: papyrus monitors overview and page: read monitoring through the signed-in site API
payload.description: Add read-only CLI commands over the existing monitoringOverview and monitoringPage queries (amplify/functions/monitoring-view/schema.ts), the same API lib/monitoring-client.ts uses. Options: --scope publication|all (all is admin-only, enforced by the server), list and cursor for pages, --json. Uses the user's papyrus login, never boto3 or an AWS profile, with no IAM fallback. A signed-out or non-staff user gets a clear refusal. No server changes. Gherkin scenarios plus unit tests; document it on p.apyr.us.
